Pretupid Launcher 0.1.3 makes installing and playing smoother: downloads pick up where they stopped, modpacks no longer disappear after a failed file, and the Skins page has a new look.

## What's new

### Downloads you can trust
- **One progress bar:** the launch popup shows the progress of the whole download instead of starting over for every step.
- **Recovers from network hiccups:** failed files are retried, then fetched again more slowly before giving up.
- **Continues where it stopped:** finished and half-finished files are kept, so pressing Play again only downloads what is missing.

### Modpacks
- **No more vanishing modpacks:** one file that fails to download no longer deletes the whole modpack. Missing files download the next time you press Play.
- **Disabled mods stay disabled:** mods a modpack ships switched off are listed as disabled instead of breaking the install.
- **No early starts:** Play waits until a modpack has finished installing.

### Pretupid Client in the launcher
- **New Install Pretupid Client switch:** it lights up when you turn it on and only appears for Fabric and Quilt on Minecraft versions the client supports.
- **Live setup:** a new instance shows that Pretupid Client and the performance mods are being added and refreshes on its own when they are ready.
- **Client icon:** Pretupid Client shows its logo in the mod list and glows while it is active.

### Looks and comfort
- **Skins page redesign:** your skin stands on a little landscape with a nametag, skins sit in a wardrobe with their faces, and removing one asks inside the launcher.
- **Read news in the launcher:** news posts open in a reader instead of the browser.
- **Minecraft-style color picker** with all 16 dye colors.
- **Livelier landscape:** birds by day, fireflies and shooting stars at night. *Animated landscape* now also covers the instance page and the Skins page.
- **Tidier settings:** every switch looks the same, and the font choice fits on one line.
- **Dialogs stay open** when you select text and let go outside of them.

## Downloads
- **Windows:** `Pretupid.Launcher_0.1.3_x64-setup.exe`
- **macOS:** `Pretupid.Launcher_0.1.3_aarch64.dmg` (Apple Silicon) or `Pretupid.Launcher_0.1.3_x64.dmg` (Intel)
- **Linux:** `.AppImage`, `.deb` or `.rpm`
- **Source:** the source code archives below

Installed launchers update themselves. Pretupid Client has its own release; the launcher installs and updates it for you.
